name: Time Frame 10
definition: Time frame elements that define a period as number of days before or after a activity.

TradePlus.name: Trade Plus
TradePlus.definition: Number of days after the trade date (T) used for the standard timeframe for the issue of a deal confirmation.

NonWorkingDayAdjustment.name: Non Working Day Adjustment
NonWorkingDayAdjustment.definition: Convention used for adjusting a date when it is not a business day.

ReferToOrderDesk.name: Refer To Order Desk
ReferToOrderDesk.definition: For the time of the issuance of the deal confirmation, the order desk must be contacted.

TradePlusRule.definition: If TradePlus is present then NonWorkingDayAdjustment must also be present.

NonWorkingDayAdjustmentRule.definition: If NonWorkingDayAdjustment is present then TradePlus must also be present.
